description:
Keep or reject a find (a long-form hook or a package): verdict is "keep" (default)
    or "reject", and the last verdict wins. The verdict is the video's on that tab: every
    find of the same video you have there carries it, so a later run that finds the video
    again shows it already kept. Kept videos come back from list_kept_finds, across all
    runs. Returns {"find_id", "verdict"}. Same as POST
    /v1/finds/{find_id}/decision. Free. Errors: 404 find_not_found.
name: keep_find
